social_circle.name: Tonya Mckethan

demographics.education: High school diploma plus medical office training

background.how_they_met: They met through church friends when David was in his twenties.
background.why_close: They have been married about eighteen years, share parenting and household expenses, and work together through budgeting, schedules, health care, and family stress.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Clear, practical texts with reminders, appointment details, grocery notes, and brief check-ins. She is direct but warm, often texting in complete sentences.

shared_activities: budget planning at the kitchen table
talking through ballots and local issues
recent_text_topics: Coordinating work shifts, school activities, Caleb's basketball practices, and Thursday choir around David's changing retail schedule.
Talking through bills after the recent car repair, utility extension, tuition payment, and grocery cuts.
Checking on David's stress, sleep, blood pressure habits, and whether he is drinking water instead of soda.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says David is married to Tonya, who works as a medical receptionist and is 'the center of the house'; Q18 describes calendar juggling with Tonya; Q44 says Tonya sat with him at the kitchen table to sort bills; Q46 says Tonya notices first when David is stressed.

social_circle.name: Maya Mckethan

background.how_they_met: Maya is David and Tonya's daughter.
background.why_close: She lives at home, shares church and school routines with the family, and David is involved in homework, rides, meals, and conversations about Black history and confidence.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Typical teen texting: short messages, quick replies, occasional slang, and practical updates about rides, school, and activities. She may act cooler than she feels about family and choir.

recent_text_topics: Bus or ride logistics when Tonya or David needs to pick her up from school or activities.
School pressure, choir or club schedules, homework, and family reminders about screen time and dinner.
Family conversations about race, confidence, and Black history after current events or school discussions.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 identifies Maya as David's 15-year-old daughter who is serious about school and sings some with youth choir; Q19 describes her weekday school routine and after-school activities; Q09 says Maya has more freedom but they still check in by phone; Q46 says Maya feels school pressure.

social_circle.name: Evelyn Mckethan

demographics.education: High school diploma plus school food-service training

background.how_they_met: Evelyn is David's mother and raised him in a Black Southern Baptist family around Angier.
background.why_close: David checks on her multiple times a week, helps with rides, prescriptions, groceries, and repairs, and carries many of her values about work, food, faith, and budgeting.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Likely mixes calls and texts; texts are short, practical, and affectionate, often about appointments, groceries, church, or whether David has eaten.

recent_text_topics: Whether she has groceries, prescriptions, and rides for appointments related to diabetes and arthritis.
Sunday food, family check-ins, church news, and updates about Maya and Caleb.
Small repairs at her place and reminders from Denise or Tonya not to let David take everything on alone.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says David's mother Evelyn lives nearby and he checks on her a few times a week; Q35 says she has diabetes and arthritis and needs rides, prescriptions, small repairs, and someone to listen; Q61 says she taught him envelope budgeting.

social_circle.name: Denise Mckethan-Johnson

background.how_they_met: Denise is David's older sister; they grew up together in Angier with both parents.
background.why_close: They talk weekly, she helps calm David's overthinking, assists with their mother's paperwork and calls, and visits around birthdays, holidays, and monthly family time.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Direct and slightly teasing. She texts in complete thoughts, sends reminders, asks follow-up questions, and is more likely than David to post or forward something political online.

recent_text_topics: Checking whether David is overthinking bills, school deadlines, or the car repair situation.
Coordinating their mother's appointments, paperwork, prescriptions, and visits.
Local politics, race and policing conversations, and family event planning in Raleigh or Angier.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Denise is David's older sister in Raleigh and they talk every week or so; Q44 says he told Denise about financial stress because she can calm him down; Q35 says Denise helps with their mother's phone calls and paperwork; Q30 says Denise is more outspoken and posts more online.

social_circle.name: Marcus Williams

background.how_they_met: Marcus and David became close through local pickup basketball and community ties in Angier.
background.why_close: They play basketball most Saturdays, share the same stage of life with work, kids, bills, and local concerns, and socialize around cookouts and Hornets games.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Casual, short texts with jokes, game times, score talk, and check-ins. Likely uses abbreviations, laughing reactions, and quick one-line replies.

shared_activities: standing by the grill talking about work, kids, and bills
recent_text_topics: Confirming Saturday pickup times, who is bringing a ball, and whether David's knee is good enough to play.
Joking about getting older, sore knees, and still trying to keep up in basketball.
Hornets games, cookout plans, work stress, kids' activities, and rising prices.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 explicitly names Marcus as someone David plays pickup ball with on Saturdays and says the basketball group is usually weekly; Q31 says David plays basketball once a week and sometimes community center league games; Q07 says friends talk during basketball, cookouts, Hornets games, and by the grill about work, kids, and bills.
